blurb: Guests can take guided tours of the working brewhouse to learn about craft brewing and sample beers. The original location offers indoor and outdoor dining including a seasonal outdoor Pint Size Park and private S'mores Trailside Dining sites. They also host events like a golf tournament and provide full-service catering for various occasions.
